description: One US House district or Senate seat: who the sitting officeholder is (incumbent, with seeking_reelection and incumbent_note saying whether they are actually on the ballot or the seat is open), every FEC-registered candidate by party with money raised/spent/cash on hand, which candidates won their primary, primary and general election dates. Primary vote counts come from Wikipedia (non-official, labelled as such, cites the state election authority); money and incumbency are FEC. A district that does not exist returns an error naming the districts that do.

district.description: House district number (1, "01") or "at-large". Required for house, ignored for senate.

special.description: Senate only: read the special-election primary page (Ohio and Florida in 2026).

state.description: US state: postal code ("IA") or full name ("Iowa").

name: race_matchup
